games.headline: Slim Shiesties handles Stroud and Proud
article: Slim Shiesties beat Stroud and Proud 133.00 to 120.30 in Week 10, a solid win decided by 12.70 points.

Slim Shiesties put up 133.00 this week, 27.9 over their projected 105.1 and the 3rd-highest score of the week. Joe Burrow carried them with 40.8 points, about a quarter of the team's total, 17.3 over his projection. James Cook III (25.7) and Parker Washington (24.7) were the other big contributors.
Jaxon Smith-Njigba led Stroud and Proud with 31.1, and C.J. Stroud added 26.0. That would have beaten most teams this week. Stroud and Proud just ran into Slim Shiesties.
The letdown for Stroud and Proud was Chris Olave, who managed 4.5 on a 12.8 projection.
The letdown for Slim Shiesties was Germie Bernard, who managed 1.0 on a 8.4 projection.

Here's the painful part for Stroud and Proud: starting Josh Downs (13.3) instead of Chris Olave (4.5) and Quinshon Judkins (14.6) instead of Zach Charbonnet (9.4) would have produced 137.20 points, enough to win.
Slim Shiesties could have scored even more by starting Antonio Williams (11.2) instead of Germie Bernard (1.0).
At quarterback, Joe Burrow (40.8) outdueled C.J. Stroud (26.0).
Slim Shiesties improves to 7-3 (3rd place), winners of 3 straight. Stroud and Proud drops to 6-4 (4th).

Next week, Slim Shiesties faces The Canberra Mob (4-6), who are coming off a 14.7-point loss to King Henry. Slim Shiesties will be without Tucker Kraft and Packers D/ST (bye), so expect some waiver-wire shopping.

Next week, Stroud and Proud faces Dena's Team 🏈 (4-6), who are coming off a 19.2-point loss to I Call Gibbs. Stroud and Proud will be without Zach Charbonnet and Jaxon Smith-Njigba (bye), so the bench is about to get some work.

games.headline: King Henry beats The Canberra Mob
article: King Henry beat The Canberra Mob 106.40 to 91.70 in Week 10, a solid win decided by 14.70 points.
George Pickens carried them with 38.0 points, over a third of the team's total, 28.1 over his projection. Bhayshul Tuten (18.8) and Rams D/ST (18.0) were the other big contributors.
The Canberra Mob managed 91.70 this week, the 3rd-lowest score of the week. CeeDee Lamb led the way with 16.7, and Justin Herbert added 16.1.
The letdown for The Canberra Mob was Woody Marks, who managed 7.0 on a 13.3 projection.

The letdown for King Henry was Geno Smith, who managed 5.0 on a 17.9 projection. King Henry might have a quarterback decision to make if Smith doesn't figure it out: Fernando Mendoza is sitting right there on the bench (and scored 13.2 this week).
At quarterback, Justin Herbert (16.1) outdueled Geno Smith (5.0).
Going into Monday night, King Henry led by 14.30, and The Canberra Mob still had Justin Herbert to play. Justin Herbert (16.1) put in work, but King Henry's Derrick Henry (16.5) more than answered.
King Henry improves to 4-6 (7th place). The Canberra Mob drops to 4-6 (11th).

Next week, King Henry faces Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup (4-6), who are coming off a 28.6-point win over The Dude Abides and have won 3 straight. King Henry will be without Rams D/ST and Jason Myers (bye), so it's time to check the waiver wire.

Next week, The Canberra Mob faces Slim Shiesties (7-3), who are coming off a 12.7-point win over Stroud and Proud and have won 3 straight. The Canberra Mob will be without Matthew Golden and Harold Fannin Jr. (bye), so it's time to check the waiver wire.
